record.paper_title: Some open problems in mutual stationarity involving inner model theory: a commentary.
record.context_brief: Generalized consistency-strength problem for mutual stationarity on an increasing sequence of regular cardinals with infinitely many non-Mahlo terms.
record.original_question: Let ⟨λ_n | n<ω⟩ be an increasing sequence of regular cardinals such that infinitely many λ_n are not Mahlo, and let γ<λ_0 be regular. What is the exact consistency strength of the assertion MS(⟨λ_n | n<ω⟩, γ), meaning that every sequence ⟨S_n | n<ω⟩ of stationary sets with S_n ⊆ λ_n ∩ cof_γ is mutually stationary?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an ordinal α and a regular cardinal γ < α, write cof_γ for the class of ordinals of cofinality γ. Given an increasing sequence ⟨λ_n : n < ω⟩ of regular cardinals and a regular cardinal γ < λ_0, a sequence ⟨S_n : n < ω⟩ with each S_n a stationary subset of λ_n ∩ cof_γ is called mutually stationary if for every algebra A on sup_n λ_n in a countable language there exists an elementary substructure M ≺ A such that, for every n, sup(M ∩ λ_n) ∈ S_n. Let MS(⟨λ_n : n < ω⟩, γ) denote the assertion that every such sequence ⟨S_n : n < ω⟩ of stationary subsets of λ_n ∩ cof_γ is mutually stationary.

Now suppose ⟨λ_n : n < ω⟩ is an increasing sequence of regular cardinals such that infinitely many λ_n are not Mahlo, and let γ < λ_0 be regular. Determine the exact consistency strength, over ZFC, of the statement MS(⟨λ_n : n < ω⟩, γ).
artifact.category_tag: mutual stationarity and inner model theory
artifact.status_search_result: The exact consistency strength of mutual stationarity on sequences of regular cardinals containing infinitely many non-Mahlo terms is an active open problem in set theory. Partial results exist (e.g., Chen-Mertens and Neeman on mutual vs. tight stationarity, and forcing constructions producing mutual stationarity at small cardinals like ℵ_n), but no exact lower/upper bound matching characterization has been published, so the precise consistency strength remains undetermined.

status_evidence.title: On the relationship between mutual and tight stationarity (Chen-Mertens & Neeman)
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs a model where every increasing ω-sequence of regular cardinals carries a mutually stationary sequence which is not tightly stationary.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work addresses mutual stationarity but does not pin down the exact consistency strength in the non-Mahlo case.

status_evidence.title: Consistency strength results about mutual stationarity (Koepke talk)
status_evidence.snippet: Forcing MS at sequences like ℵ3, ℵ5, ℵ7, ... ; consistency strength results.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial bounds for consistency strength of MS at non-Mahlo cardinals are known.
